scope: Current-checker conditional planning model. Allowances are judgments, not measurements.

assumption_explanations.lean.build_ratio: 5% allowance based on nearby 65536-bit cached-input construction/check comparison; not measured at262144.
assumption_explanations.lean.layout_factor: 25% allowance for radix/halo/layout adaptation. Prefix polynomials must be cached; not a guarantee for fixed512-anchor products.
assumption_explanations.lean.native_construction_core_years: 100core-years allowance for source data, native coverage selection, certificate production and packing. Native Pratt construction alone is much smaller.
assumption_explanations.lean.assembly_core_years: 200core-years unmeasured allowance for certified access, aggregation and shared data. No complete distributed pipeline exists.
assumption_explanations.mm0.index_seconds: 0.25microseconds perselectedmask allowance for source-index/prime provenance and perword full-mask closure. Schematic benchmark omits these; sensitivity is large.
assumption_explanations.mm0.other_core_years: 1000core-years unmeasured allowance for prime certificates, PA library/source preparation, amortized bootstrap and assembly. Assumes sufficiently large sound shards.

warnings: No complete Goldbach proof or globally successful fixed-size anchor cover was built.
MM0 benchmark library uses schematic axioms and concludes ok, not PA Goldbach; actual word coverage was independently checked in Python.
Current-checker estimates are not lower bounds on optimized proof systems or all possible mathematics.
Native arithmetic figures exclude a complete verified accelerator. Both provers must be allowed kernel changes under that broader comparison.
Most timed inner loops are warmed; host load, memory hierarchy, large dependency stores and I/O can change extrapolation.
Lean timing is inner monotonic wall time; prime certificate and MM0 timing use process CPU. Dedicated-core projection is an assumption.
The idealized fusion scenario removes separate emission cost without benchmarking the resulting implementation.
Planning envelopes are judgments, not statistical confidence intervals or proved upper bounds.
